title: The HUSKY – Products Filter for WooCommerce Professional plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based SQL…
description: The HUSKY – Products Filter for WooCommerce Professional plugin for WordPress contains a time-based SQL Injection vulnerability in versions up to and including 1.4.7. This flaw allows authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher to inject additional SQL queries via the 'link' parameter (specifically the inner 'woof_text' query parameter). The vulnerability arises from insufficient escaping and preparation of user-supplied input. Exploitation requires a valid product_messenger nonce, which can be easily obtained by any logged-in user due to the way the nonce is issued through an AJAX endpoint that can be triggered by attacker-controlled parameters.
